schema.description: The job's item_id, copied character for character from the chosen job in the recommendations list given in the [CALL CONTEXT] block at the start of the call. If that block has no recommendations list, there are NO jobs this call: do not call this tool. Never construct, complete or guess an id (made-up ids like 7cacd94e-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 were sent on 2026-11-09 test calls); never use an id from the prompt's examples.
